name: hydrant
title: Hydrant
description: A fire-station theme on appliance red: the regular week is a row of yellow hydrant marker plates, each a heavy black H with the day above the crossbar and the time below, standing on white posts beside white signage capitals, with the diary, the news and the crew on white report sheets.

tokens.--font-sign: the signage capitals: the name, the menu, headings, everything lettered on a plate, dates and names in the lists
tokens.--font-body: body text: the intro, what is typed on the report sheets, the join note
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing in the small capitals: the menu, places, statuses, tags, table headings
tokens.--color-bg: the ground of every page (appliance red by day, the dark engine bay at night)
tokens.--color-text: lettering on the ground: the name, the menu, the headline, what happens beside each plate
tokens.--color-muted: quieter lettering on the ground: the founded line, places, block headings, dates of news items
tokens.--color-accent: the mark under the current menu entry and the inner ring of the focus outline
tokens.--color-band: the reflective bands under the masthead and above the station card, the band beside the intro on wide screens, and the posts and kerb line under the plates
tokens.--color-plate: the enamel of every plate: the regular week, the event date, the open-to-all status, the join link
tokens.--color-plate-ink: the H and the lettering on a plate, and the ground of the cancelled plate
tokens.--color-sheet: the report sheets that carry page text, the diary, the news list and the crew
tokens.--color-sheet-ink: text on a sheet, the heavy rule under a sheet heading, and the members-only plate
tokens.--color-sheet-muted: secondary text on a sheet: descriptions, times, places, roles, past dates
tokens.--color-sheet-rule: the thin ruled lines between entries, people and table rows
tokens.--color-link: links in the text of a sheet
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-focus: the outer ring of the keyboard focus outline
tokens.--shadow-plate: the rim, highlight and edge that make a plate read as enamel (a faint glow at night)
tokens.--shadow-sheet: the hard edge under a report sheet
tokens.--measure-wide: maximum width of the page: masthead, headline, the row of plates, station card
tokens.--measure-sheet: maximum width of a report sheet
tokens.--measure-text: maximum width of a line of running text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of plates, sheets, statuses and images
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy rules: the kerb line under the plates, sheet headings, the current menu mark, table heads
tokens.--plate-width: width of a plate in the regular week (the event plate is a fifth wider)
tokens.--plate-stroke: thickness of the H: its two uprights and its crossbar
tokens.--plate-notch: least height of the space that holds a figure above or below the crossbar
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a title and the line under it
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside labels, under sheet headings
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, the gap between a plate and its words, padding of a ruled entry
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks and between sheets
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the headline and at the foot of the page
